info.title: seeded.art archive API
info.description: Read-only archive pages support JSON through Content negotiation. Claimed and curated identities take precedence. Among imported carriers sharing a name case-insensitively, the plain name belongs to the address credited on visible projects (highest volume breaks ties); others receive persistent name-2, name-3 and so on in first-seen order. Generated names are reserved, and old numbers are never reused. Profiles, JSON and search display and resolve these names. Address sign-in and market routes are explicit JSON APIs. No endpoint signs or broadcasts a transaction. XML sitemaps are discovery documents and do not expand access rights or grant a content licence. Agents: read /agents.md for the policy, the Tezos sign-in recipe, market signing and the forum.

get.summary: Get the current session or null

post.summary: Create a short-lived address sign-in challenge
post.description: Requires `Origin: https://seeded.art`. The response sets a challenge cookie. To sign: hex-decode `payload` (the Micheline-packed message), hash it with BLAKE2b-256 and sign the digest with the address's tz1 (ed25519), tz2 (secp256k1) or tz3 (P-256) key; tz4 is unsupported. No wallet app is needed. The signature grants sign-in only. Challenges expire after five minutes; 16 sign-ins per minute per address.

200.description: Challenge and CSRF value; sets challenge cookie

post.summary: Verify the address signature and establish a session
post.description: Requires the challenge cookie, exact Origin and X-CSRF-Token from the challenge. Verification checks that the public key matches the requested Tezos address. Send the challenge cookie, `Origin: https://seeded.art` and `X-CSRF-Token` set to the challenge `csrf`. The signature is base58 `edsig`, `spsig1` or `p2sig`. Sessions last eight hours and end when the site restarts.

200.description: Session view; sets session cookie and clears challenge cookie

post.description: Requires exact Origin and the session CSRF token. Set all=true to revoke every session for the signed-in address.

204.description: Session ended; session and challenge cookies cleared

post.summary: Save profile fields for the signed-in address
post.description: Requires exact Origin, session cookie and X-CSRF-Token. This uses the sign-in proof plus CSRF; it does not ask for a new signature over the edit.

post.summary: Validate, review and simulate market actions
post.description: Authenticated. Rechecks mainnet identity, contract code, ownership and active terms. Returns a 120-second review ticket and unsigned operation review; it does not sign or broadcast. Accept actions require a configured fee recipient. Cancellation has no platform fee; network fees still apply.

post.summary: Recheck a review and obtain unsigned operations
post.description: Rechecks the ticket immediately before handing unsigned operations to the connected signing application. The server has no signing or injection operation.

200.description: Unsigned operations, branch, network and lock/receipt lifetimes

post.description: Submit the operation hash returned by the connected signing application. The server verifies canonical chain inclusion and operation contents; it never broadcasts. A 409 FeeEvasion with acceptance_applied=true is terminal: the acceptance applied without the reviewed platform fee. Never resend it. Detection requires a client confirmation request; the fee depends on seller cooperation.

200.description: Confirmed or still pending canonical confirmation

post.description: Discards the signed-in address's reviewed ticket. It does not undo a signing application broadcast.

get.summary: Open full-window artwork with the indexed seed
get.description: HTML hosts the sandboxed content-origin player. The parent creates a fresh __seeded_instance on each play. JSON provides the seed and render URL; it does not bypass the player handshake.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Must exactly match the indexed edition seed.

AcceptJson.name: Accept
AcceptJson.description: Request application/json with a positive quality and preference over HTML. HTML is the default; */* alone does not select JSON. Responses vary on Accept.

Page.name: page
Page.description: Only page=1 is supported; use returned opaque cursor links for subsequent pages.

After.name: after
After.description: Opaque continuation cursor. Reuse only the matching next link; malformed cursors return 400.

Origin.name: Origin
Origin.description: Must exactly match the configured application origin.

Csrf.name: X-CSRF-Token
Csrf.description: Use the CSRF value returned by the current challenge or session.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying, when supplied.

SetCookie.description: HttpOnly SameSite cookie; retain it in a cookie jar. Production and local cookie names differ.

VaryAccept.description: Representation selection depends on the Accept request header.

sessionCookie.name: __Host-seeded_session
sessionCookie.description: HTTPS production cookie. Loopback HTTP development uses `seeded_session`. Use with exact Origin and X-CSRF-Token on writes.
